entries.d17e86d2b4cde4ee: A single-segment business that provides technical services in mechanical design, electronic design and software development as a development partner, mainly to major manufacturers and other customer companies. Engineers who are employees provide their technical capabilities either by being dispatched to design and development work carried out within customer companies, or by undertaking design and development work contracted by customers. The business categories of customer companies span transport equipment-related, machinery-related, information and communications and precision equipment-related, electrical and electronic equipment and semiconductor circuit-related, and information processing and software-related. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,193 million.
